newsitem.title: INDIA: India CRISIL gives 'P1+' rating for Kotak debt.
newsitem.headline: India CRISIL gives 'P1+' rating for Kotak debt.

text.p: India's Credit Rating Information Services of India Ltd (CRISIL) said on Wednesday it had assigned a "P1+" rating to the short term debt programme of Kotak Mahindra Capital Company (KMCC) indicating that the degree of safety regarding the timely payment of interest and principal is very strong.

The statement said that the existing merchant banking business of Kotak Mahindra Finance Limited (KMFL) has been transferred to KMCC, KMCC has been promoted by KMFL and Goldman Sachs (GS) and the venture is expected to exploit the synergy of international operations of GS and established merchant banking activities of KMFL in the domestic market.

CRISIL said in a statement the company has been incorporated as a company with unlimited liability which would signify that in case of inability of KMCC to meet its debt repayments, the parent companies would be legally obligated to meet them.

KMCC is one of the leading merchant bankers in the domestic capital markets. In the current environment of depressed capital markets, the business prospects of KMCC are likely to be affected in the short to medium term.

However, being a leading merchant banker KMCC would be more comfortably placed than other players. The rating also factors in the conservative deployment of its funds which is likely to protect its asset quality while earning reasonable returns, CRISIL said.
